Name: Ball (10 in.)
Description: Large 10-inch ball suitable for sports and games requiring a substantial sphere. Can be used for various ball games or as a toy.

Name: Ball (2 in.)
Description: Small 2-inch ball, inexpensive toy or game piece. Suitable for juggling, children's games, or as a simple plaything.

Name: Ball (5 in.)
Description: Medium 5-inch ball, versatile size for various games and sports. Common choice for casual play.

Name: Billiards Gear
Description: Complete set for playing billiards, including cues, balls, and accessories. Requires a billiards table (sold separately).

Name: Board Game
Description: Various board games from simple checkers to elaborate strategy games. Cost varies by complexity and quality of materials.

Name: Book of Puzzles
Description: Collection of riddles, logic puzzles, and brain teasers. Popular among scholars and those who enjoy intellectual challenges.

Name: Bowling Set
Description: Pins and ball for lawn bowling or similar games. Cost varies by quality of materials.

Name: Cards
Description: Playing cards for various card games. Simple paper cards cost 1 sp, while elaborate hand-painted or magical decks can cost up to 100 gp.

Name: Croquet Set
Description: Mallets, balls, and wickets for playing croquet. A popular lawn game among the nobility.

Name: Crossword
Description: Word puzzle on paper or parchment. Simple crosswords cost 1 cp, while more elaborate or themed versions cost up to 1 sp.

Name: Dartboard Set
Description: Board and darts for playing darts. Common in taverns and popular for gambling.

Name: Dice
Description: Standard gaming dice, typically a set of six-sided dice. Essential for many gambling games.

Name: Dominos
Description: Set of domino tiles for playing various domino games. Simple wooden sets cost 1 sp, while ivory or decorated sets can cost up to 25 gp.

Name: Halfling Jugglesticks
Description: Specialized juggling equipment popular among halflings. These balanced sticks are designed for elaborate juggling routines and tricks.

Name: Harrow Carrying Case
Description: Protective case for storing and transporting a Harrow deck. Keeps the valuable cards safe from damage.

Name: Harrow Deck
Description: Traditional Varisian fortune-telling deck consisting of 54 cards. Used for divination, gambling, and storytelling. Each card depicts powerful imagery and symbolism.

Name: Harrow Mat
Description: Cloth mat with traditional Harrow spread patterns marked on it. Used for laying out Harrow cards during readings or games.

Name: Horseshoes Game
Description: Set of horseshoes and stakes for playing the classic tossing game. Popular outdoor entertainment.

Name: Imperial Conquest
Description: Elaborate strategy board game simulating military conquest and empire building. Expensive and complex, favored by nobles and military strategists.

Name: Kite
Description: Flying toy ranging from simple paper kites (1 sp) to elaborate masterworks with precious materials and magical enhancements (up to 2,000 gp).

Name: Loaded Dice (average)
Description: Weighted dice designed to favor certain results. Average quality provides some advantage but may be detected by careful observers.

Name: Loaded Dice (superior)
Description: Expertly crafted weighted dice that are very difficult to detect. Provides better advantage while being less obvious than average loaded dice.

Name: Marked Cards
Description: Playing cards with subtle marks on the backs allowing the informed user to identify them. Used for cheating at card games.

Name: Polo Gear
Description: Mallets and ball for playing polo. Does not include horses or field. A sport of the wealthy.

Name: Puzzle Box
Description: Mechanical puzzle requiring specific manipulations to open. Simple boxes cost 1 gp, while masterwork or magical puzzle boxes with multiple stages can cost up to 1,000 gp.

Name: Rounders Gear
Description: Bat and ball for playing rounders, a bat-and-ball game. Inexpensive and popular among common folk.

Name: Scent Salts
Description: Aromatic salts used for entertainment or to revive someone who has fainted. Can also be used in pranks.

Name: Signal Kite Kit
Description: Kite designed specifically for signaling, with colored ribbons or flags. Can be used to send simple messages over distance.

Name: Tennis Gear
Description: Rackets and ball for playing tennis. Does not include net or court. Popular among nobility.

Name: Terror Kite
Description: Kite designed to look frightening, possibly resembling a dragon, demon, or other monster. Used for entertainment, intimidation, or scaring away birds.
